How it works

Replace your timer with a quiet gallery wall

No progress rings, scores or pop-up reminders. Just a painting, a numbered plaque and a quiet countdown.

  1. Choose a gallery

    Swipe between six galleries. Each holds eight paintings with its own framing style.

  2. Set aside some focused time

    15, 25 or 45 minutes. Tap the plaque to read about the artwork without interrupting your timer.

  3. The painting stays

    Finish to add the painting to this gallery. The next hangs to its right. Collect all eight to earn a commemorative badge.

House rules

A few house rules

No account needed

Open and start. No sign-up, login, social feeds or leaderboards.

Your data stays here

Focus history and collections stay on your iPhone. No cloud sync, ads or behavioral tracking.

Stay in the foreground

Locking or leaving pauses the timer. Return within 30 seconds to resume; otherwise the session ends. The same painting stays for a fresh start.

Collected on first completion

Collect each artwork once. Revisit after completing a gallery to add focus history without duplicates.

Ready before you begin

Start only after the image has downloaded. Cached works and collections are available offline; losing connection during a session won’t interrupt it.

Light won’t rush you

Walls and lighting stay the same at the start and finish. No flashes, particles or progress bars.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Can I switch to another app while focusing?

Briefly. The timer pauses in the background or when locked; time away does not count. Return within 30 seconds to resume automatically. A longer absence interrupts the session. System dialogs do not interrupt it.

What if I leave midway?

EXIT asks you to confirm. Ending adds no artwork, but the painting stays in place for a new full session.

Will my collection survive a new phone or reinstall?

Collections are local and are deleted with the app. Restore Purchases can recover Pro access, but not collections or focus history.

Do I need an internet connection?

The first viewing downloads an image. Cached artworks work offline; losing connection after a session starts does not affect completion.

Who owns the artworks’ copyright?

Images are public-domain artworks from The Met’s Open Access program. Chinese titles are our translations; artwork details retain original titles, sources and credits.

How do I cancel a subscription?

On iPhone, go to Settings → your Apple Account → Subscriptions, or manage subscriptions in the app’s settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.
